author: Nick Bellows
description:
Detects powershell.exe or pwsh.exe process creation where the command line either carries an
encoded command (-enc / -EncodedCommand / -ec) or combines a hidden window with a download
cradle (Net.WebClient, DownloadString, Invoke-WebRequest, IEX). Both shapes are how Atomic Red
Team T1059.001 launches payloads and how commodity loaders stage second stages. Plain
interactive or scripted PowerShell without those flags is deliberately out of scope.
ATT&CK Enterprise v19.2 and the Atomic test catalog were accessed 2026-08-29.
false_positives: Management agents that intentionally run encoded commands (some RMM tools, Intune remediation scripts); allowlist by parent process and signer rather than by command text.
Administrators pasting encoded one-liners from vendor documentation.
name: SIGMA - PowerShell Launched With an Encoded Command or a Hidden Window Plus a Download Cradle
query: winlog.channel:Microsoft\-Windows\-Sysmon\/Operational AND (event.code:1 AND ((process.executable.caseless:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe)) AND ((process.command_line:(*\ \-e\ * OR *\ \-ec\ * OR *\ \-en\ * OR *\ \-enc*)) OR ((process.command_line:(*\ \-w\ hidden* OR *\ \-window\ hidden* OR *\ \-windowstyle\ hidden*)) AND (process.command_line:(*Net.WebClient* OR *DownloadString\(* OR *DownloadFile\(* OR *Invoke\-WebRequest* OR *IEX\ * OR *IEX\(*))))))
